steam.hint: Paste your Steam profile URL, your SteamID64 or your custom name. The profile and the game details must be public, otherwise Steam won't let us read the library: in that case, sign in with Steam.

gog.hint: Open the login page, sign in with your GOG account, then copy the address of the blank page you land on from the browser bar: the code we need is in there. You only do this once.

epic.hint: Open the login page, sign in with your Epic account, then copy the JSON shown on screen — the whole thing is fine, no need to pick the code out of it. You only do this once.

amazon.hint: Open the login page and sign in with your Amazon account — the store is the US one, but a non-US account signs in just fine. Once you land on the amazon.com home page, copy the address from the browser bar. Connecting registers an “AGSLauncher for Windows” device on your Amazon account, which you can remove any time from your Amazon settings.

psn.hint: First sign in to playstation.com in your browser and tick “Trust this browser”, then open the link above: the page answers with a line like '{"npsso":"…"}'. Paste the whole thing, or just the value. An empty npsso or an error means you are not signed in yet. Note: on PlayStation the connection lasts about ten days, then you have to do this again.

unresolved.description: These library entries weren't recognised. They're usually beta clients or things that aren't games: you can link them to the right game or hide them, saying what they are.

unresolved.hiddenHint: Entries you took out of “needs attention”. They stay here after the next imports: if one turns out to be a real game, you can still link it.

credits.title: Credits and licences
credits.subtitle: Who makes Ludex possible: the data, the software and the icons.

about.text: Ludex is free software, born to keep your backlog always at hand and manage it the way you like. Suggestions and new ideas are welcome. With love  ♥

services.title: Services and data sources
services.intro: Ludex makes nothing up: game data and libraries come from these services. We are not affiliated with any of them, and names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
services.igdb: Game data provided by IGDB.com: titles, covers, genres, platforms, similar games.
services.hltb: How long a game takes to finish.
services.wikidata: Identifiers that tie the same game together across sources.

software.title: Open source software
software.intro: Ludex is built on free software. These are the main parts, each with its own licence.
software.react: The interface, on the web and on the phone.
software.tanstack: The web app: routing, server rendering and data.
software.tamagui: The design system shared by web and mobile.
software.react-native-web: Runs the native components in the browser.
software.orpc: The typed link between client and server.
software.inter: The text typeface, served by Fontsource.
software.space-grotesk: The heading typeface, served by Fontsource.
